summary.text: Lisa Mazur is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 44, where she assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a business owner from Goffstown.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Mazur lives in Goffstown, New Hampshire.
Her career experience includes owning Piper's Cove and working as the outreach director of Manchester Christian Church.
Mazur's 2023-2024 committee assignment was the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee.
